title: Approval hook: a Read of a missing file is a denial that blocks the fallback
lead: *Proposed.* A Read of a file that does not exist is not a policy question: the hook allows it (Claude's Read then reports the missing file to the model). And a denial made by ork's own approval point (S356) is a policy answer the model already received; it does not block falling back to the next row the way an allowlist denial does.
findings_note: S304 trial 3 (2026-11-15, run ork-20261114-224559-2b00): the claude-local implementer's Read of its own progress note, before the note existed, was denied by the PreToolUse hook ("cannot count Read lines: stat ...: no such file or directory", `internal/agent/claude/pretool.go:113-116`). The run recorded 2 denials, so when the local implementer hit the 90 min limit the claude sonnet fallback did not take over (`internal/engine/round.go:657` requires no denials) and the run stopped.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: *Proposed.* `fallingBack` excludes runs with denials because, before S356, a denial meant the allowlist lacked something the owner had to add. Under S356 a local role is denied by design (500-line cap, outside paths), so any such denial would stop a local run at the time limit instead of falling back. The trial 3 denials were also false: the file the role was told to keep did not exist yet.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `internal/agent/claude/pretool_test.go`: `TestPretoolMissingRead` verifies an unbounded Read of a missing in-worktree file is allowed, while the allowlist and path boundary still apply.
- `internal/engine/round_test.go`: `TestApprovalDenialTimeoutFallback` verifies a timed-out claude-local implementer with approval-point denials reaches the saved fallback report, including across fresh-session restart; changing only the denial source to allowlist still stops. The allowlist case is a regression control that already passes before implementation.
- `internal/daemon/runner_test.go`: `TestClaudeRunnerCountsApprovalDenials` verifies hook-only, duplicate hook/vendor, mixed and vendor-only denial results.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Red tests above.
2. Allow the missing-file Read; mark approval-point denials on the result so `fallingBack` can tell them apart.
3. Docs: `docs/design.md`. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`.

Owner decisions (2026-11-15): Where does the approval-point mark on a denial live? -> result-only: add a field on `engine.Result` (for example a count of approval-point denials). It is set in `internal/daemon/runner.go` from the hook's denial list before the dedup against Claude's `permission_denials`, and added up across a fresh-session restart at `internal/engine/round.go:547`. `fallingBack` stops blocking when every denial in the round is an approval-point one. Nothing is persisted and `docs/state.md` is unchanged..
